chunks: He said: 'You bring me the good news now, when old age has come upon me. What good news are you giving me then?'

key_terms.مَسَّنِيَ: Has come upon me / touched me

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Zakariya say when the angels gave him the good news of a son in old age?
ai.summary: In Surah Maryam, Prophet Zakariya (AS) responds to the angels with a rhetorical question expressing awe at the possibility of fathering a child in old age, emphasizing that such a miracle is solely from Allah. Shia scholars highlight this moment as a testament to *tawakkul* (trust in God) and the transcendence of natural laws by Divine Will, contrasting human limitation with infinite power. This narrative underscores the theme of *ba'th* (resurrection) and the renewal of life, serving as a precursor to the miraculous birth of Yahya (AS).
